reviewConclusion: Functional simulation visuals remain procedural and data-responsive. Twelve small, untextured Kenney Nature Kit GLBs are bundled as an optional decorative palette only; they do not represent cells, zones, crop outcomes, or sensors.

deliveryPolicy.decorationGuidance: These 12 files are a small art-direction palette, not a requirement to render them all together. Start with 2–3 distinct GLB types in the default view, keep them outside selectable cells, and preserve the TRD's full-scene draw-call ceiling; remove decoration first when profiling shows pressure.
deliveryPolicy.preparation: glTF Transform CLI 4.5.1 flatten repaired the source scene-root/parent mismatch and pruned redundant nodes without changing mesh geometry; all 12 runtime GLBs validated with zero errors and zero warnings.

proceduralAssets.implementation: One BoxGeometry and shared material in an InstancedMesh. Per-cell transform/color comes from the active scenario and zoning result.
proceduralAssets.reasonExternalModelIsIncorrect: The cells must update after edits and clustering. A static terrain/field GLB cannot faithfully encode cell data or retain efficient picking.

proceduralAssets.implementation: Generate zone boundary paths, hatching, heatmaps, cell hit targets, brush cursor, legends, and labels from the latest result in SVG/Canvas/DOM.
proceduralAssets.reasonExternalModelIsIncorrect: Zones, membership strengths, and labels are calculated results, not static scenery. This supplies the keyboard-accessible no-WebGL fallback.

proceduralAssets.implementation: Three instanced primitive batches: 8-sided cylinder base, 6-sided cylinder mast, and detail-0 icosahedron beacon.
proceduralAssets.reasonExternalModelIsIncorrect: The specified marker is illustrative—not a real device—and needs easy placement, color changes, and batching. A sensor GLB would be heavier and risks implying a live stream.

proceduralAssets.implementation: Sparse instanced crossed planes or three tapered blade triangles, using a flat shared material and no texture.
proceduralAssets.reasonExternalModelIsIncorrect: Dense grass/plant meshes over cells add overdraw and obscure soil data. The UI specification calls for clean parametric crop silhouettes; the few approved Kenney props remain sparse, decorative perimeter accents.

proceduralAssets.implementation: Centroids use minimal line/point geometry; root-zone layers and crop silhouettes are parametric SVG or simple layered geometry. A few optional Kenney accents can decorate the field edge; a later Spline version remains optional.
proceduralAssets.reasonExternalModelIsIncorrect: Information-bearing layers remain procedural. Decorative assets are optional, lazy, and must retain an SVG/PNG fallback.

explicitlyExcluded.assetClass: Dense or field-wide grass, foliage, crop, or plant GLB
explicitlyExcluded.evidence: The functional view is an editable soil map, and the UI spec requires low-height crop markers plus clean parametric SVG/Three.js geometry. Dense foliage obscures cells, raises overdraw, and does not improve task completion.

explicitlyExcluded.assetClass: Static farm terrain, soil scan, or photogrammetry GLB
explicitlyExcluded.evidence: The scenario is synthetic and data-responsive. Static terrain cannot reflect soil edits, zoning/membership modes, or the 2D fallback.

explicitlyExcluded.assetClass: Pump, irrigation hardware, realistic sensor, or farm machinery GLB
explicitlyExcluded.evidence: Real sensors/pumps, irrigation replay, and pump simulation are out of MVP scope. These props would create an inaccurate capability claim.

needTest: The visual remains useful after trying the approved procedural/SVG approach.
It is decorative only and cannot carry labels, controls, results, or the accessible interaction path.
It does not imply a live sensor, pump, irrigation capability, or real-farm evidence.
licenseTest: Record creator, exact source URL, model-specific license URL, license version, and download date.
Accept only a model with an explicit CC0, CC-BY 4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, or comparably permissive reuse license. Respect attribution where applicable.
Do not infer a model license from a marketplace-wide label or search result.
integrityTest: Record original and optimized SHA-256 checksums and file size.
Validate the optimized GLB with a glTF validator and record zero errors.
Inspect it for logos, unwanted animation/cameras/lights, unrelated meshes, and hidden large textures before accepting it.

reviewedSourceNotBundled.name: Poly Haven
reviewedSourceNotBundled.finding: Poly Haven was reviewed but not selected for this preparation pass: its detailed nature models would add texture/geometry work beyond the cleaner, tiny Kenney low-poly accents selected for the current visual direction.

verification.licenseObligationsForBundledModels: CC0; attribution is not required. The source License.txt is retained beside the models.
verification.manifestIntegrity: All 12 runtime GLBs have SHA-256 records and were validated with glTF Transform CLI 4.5.1: zero errors and zero warnings. Informational unused TEXCOORD_0 records remain on these untextured models.
runtimeChecksBeforeShipping: Capture frame time, draw calls, triangles, texture memory, transfer bytes, and load time at the maximum 768-cell field state.
Test a mobile-quality profile at DPR 1 and hide optional crop markers first under pressure.
Disable WebGL and confirm all editing, inspection, zoning, crop comparison, labels, and keyboard operation remain functional.
Enable prefers-reduced-motion and confirm all field drift/ripples/travel animation stop.
